Why was RAG first proposed in 2018?: RAG was first proposed in 2020, not 2018.
Why does RAG require retraining the LLM: RAG does **not** require retraining the LLM every time new data is added. According to the context, RAG reduces the need to retrain LLMs with new data, saving on computational and financial costs.
Which article by Wired described RAG as: The description you’re referring to comes from Ars Technica, not Wired. The text states: “According to Ars Technica, ‘RAG is a way of improving LLM performance, in essence by blending the LLM process with a web search or other document look‑up process to help LLMs stick to the facts.’”
